verdict.rationale: Kick documents a first-party Kick CLI with its own quickstart: authenticate, pick a workspace, and pull transactions or financial statements from the terminal. The AI docs and pricing page also position the CLI alongside MCP for automating workflows across workspaces. Missing for 10: a command reference or detail beyond the quickstart summary, evidence of write/automation operations via the CLI (the evidence describes lookups and reports), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
